Languages

This page collects three minimal introductions. Each one is a stub: the first step is written, the rest is an outline, and the page ends with links to a longer free course and to Wikipedia.

Three languages come up in the basic work of this course. HTML is the markup of a page. JavaScript is what a browser can run after the page is open. Python is a file of steps a helper can run.

Another lesson can name one of these in a sentence and open the page in a new tab, so the lesson stays put.

LanguageIn this coursePage
HTMLMarkup a browser reads as a page.R.3.1
JavaScriptInstructions a browser can run after a page is open.R.3.2
